AbletonOSC README (checked 2026-10-28). Optional params: index_min, index_max (not exercised). User run 2026-10-28: 4 tracks read correctly.
AbletonOSC README (checked 2026-10-28). Params: track_id, mute (1/0). User run 2026-10-28: both directions written and read back via /live/track/get/mute (R1-R3 ok) on a MIDI track of a test set.

AbletonOSC README 'Track API' (checked 2026-10-28): /live/track/get/mute track_id -> track_id, mute; source abletonosc/track.py properties_rw contains 'mute'. Read-back for track.mute.set; until #42 it borrowed that gate. User run 2026-10-28 (script 0.1.0): read R0-R4 on track 1 '2-MIDI', raw=(False,)/(True,) matching each preceding write.

AbletonOSC README (checked 2026-10-28). Covers LOM changes, not file operations. User run 2026-10-28: one undo reverted the last mute write (R4 ok). Only a single undo after a single write was verified; multi-step undo is not. Limitation (user decision, PR #42): script 0.1.0 did not re-read the whole set after undo (bug #39), so an undo that reverted an unrelated action could not be excluded; run was on Live's default 4-track set, R4 = unmuted. #50 run 4 (2026-10-29, live_import 0.2.0, https://github.com/castorsalzmann-ui/AbeltonGod/issues/50#issuecomment-6495458918): one undo right after clip_slot.create_audio_clip removed the clip, read back with the whole track list; after user interaction in Live (run 2) one undo showed no visible change, cause not established.

AbletonOSC README (checked 2026-10-28). Param: index (-1 = end). Needed for Phase 03. Kept 'supported' in #50 because this entry claims reversible=true and its undo was never run on the user's machine: user run 1 (2026-10-29 10:32, Live 12.4 per API; user reports 12.4.5; live_import 0.1.0, https://github.com/castorsalzmann-ui/AbeltonGod/issues/50#issuecomment-6493629463) created the track and read it back (track_names gained '3-Audio', all 8 slots empty), but song.undo was SKIPPED in that run; runs 2-4 (script 0.2.0) imported onto an existing track. Missing for 'tested': one live_import >= 0.2.0 run with target 'n' (new track), nothing touched in Live, undo answered yes, result block showing song.undo PASS with the track count and all track names back.

Not in the AbletonOSC README (only /live/clip_slot/create_clip for empty MIDI clips); sent as /live/clip_slot/create_audio_clip through the AbeltonGod extension (scripts/install_abletonosc_extension.py, pinned to AbletonOSC commit 0ca68214). User runs 2, 3 and 4 on 2026-10-29 (Live 12.4 per API; user reports 12.4.5; Windows 11, live_import 0.2.0, existing audio track 0, slot 0, absolute WAV path): clip_slot.create_audio_clip PASS and clip file_path read back equal to the WAV in all three (run 2: https://github.com/castorsalzmann-ui/AbeltonGod/issues/50#issuecomment-6495315110, runs 3 and 4: #issuecomment-6495458918). Listening: the user heard the kick in run 1 (new track, chat confirmation, #issuecomment-6493153063) and run 2; runs 3 and 4 recorded user_hears_kick: yes, but it is not established whether the clip was launched in run 3 or in run 4 (the run-3 plan was to answer without playing, #issuecomment-6495356008). Live renames a default-named target track after the clip ('1-Audio' -> '1-centre_s1001_v0'). Undo: run 4 (whole run 16 s, 12:29:47-12:30:03) one song.undo removed the clip and restored the track name, read back; it is not established whether the clip was launched (or anything else done in Live) between import and undo in run 4, so run 4 neither supports nor rules out the launch hypothesis. Limitations: undo after user interaction in Live is not reliable - run 2 (39 s between import and undo; the script had asked the user to launch the clip in Live) sent one undo and the read-back showed no change after 3 polls, cause not established; run 3: the set was already back to the pre-import state before the script's undo (most likely the user's own interaction in Live, not confirmed); the pre-check refused and sent nothing (correct, https://github.com/castorsalzmann-ui/AbeltonGod/issues/50#issuecomment-6495491039). Verified only on an existing audio track, Session view, one WAV file; not on a new track with live_import 0.2.0, not in Arrangement, not with other formats.
No known API route. Use resampling or manual export.
